senses.gloss:
णश r. 4th cl. (ऊ) णशू (नश्यति) To disappear, to cease to be, to perish,
to be annihilated. अदर्शने नाशे च दिवा-पर-सक-सेट् ।

णस r., 1st cl. (नसते (प्रणसते) 1. To be crooked, (literally or metaphorical-
ly. ).
 2. To bend, to make curved or crooked. भ्वा-आत्म-अक-सेट् ।

णास (ऋ) णासृ r. 1st cl. (नसते प्रणासते) To sound in particular manner,
to snore. भ्वा-आत्म-अक-सेट् ।
